# netbox_permissions (Data Source)

Retrieves all permissions from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_permissions" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "name"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "permissions_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_permissions.example.permissions[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `permissions` (Attributes List) The permissions found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `actions` (List of String) The actions of the permissions.
- `constraints` (String) The constraints of the permissions.
- `description` (String) A description of the permissions.
- `enabled` (Boolean) The enabled of the permissions.
- `groups` (List of Number) The IDs of the groups of the permissions.
- `id` (Number) The id of the permissions.
- `name` (String) The name of the permissions.
- `object_types` (List of String) The object types of the permissions.
- `users` (List of Number) The IDs of the users of the permissions.
